item: Row 376 (Audit 17 SEC-4): a test-only ratchet on HTML sinks whose value no escaper clears
summary: Audit 17 counted the innerHTML sinks in src/static and could not say each escapes. scripts/innerhtml_escape_scan.py (row 352's lexer: comments, strings, templates and regexes read as such) reads every .innerHTML/.outerHTML = or += and every .insertAdjacentHTML( in the non-vendor static JS (sw.js aside), takes out only esc()/escHtml() calls, t() of one string literal, and .length/.toFixed() with what they are read from, and counts a sink whose right-hand side still holds a name. On main: 994 sinks, 520 counted, in 406 units (file, innermost named function). configs/innerhtml_unescaped_sinks.txt lists them as 'file unit count'; tests/test_innerhtml_escape_scan.py requires the scan to equal it exactly (no ceiling number, row 352's shape), so a new raw value in an HTML sink fails and a fix lowers its count in the same PR. A listed line is not a finding: most are strings built from escaped parts a few lines up, which a data-flow-free scan cannot clear. Fixtures cover each clearing form and each refusal (raw template hole, concatenation, +=, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, tf with raw variables, t of a variable, comment or string that says esc, lookalike escapers, statements over lines, per-unit counting). Blind spots in the docstring: escaping in the wrong context (href, single-quoted attribute with escHtml), other sinks (document.write, DOMParser, srcdoc, on* attributes), names used only as conditions counted strictly. The security read's fixes: a template literal's own line breaks no longer end a right-hand side (the dominant multi-line style had hidden 18 sinks), ||= &&= ??= are sinks, only simple/vendor, guis/vendor and the top-level sw.js are left out by exact path, and where esc/escHtml are defined is pinned (six files), since an escaper is cleared by name; the docstring says the count is per sink, not per value.
